## smarter patient monitoring. simplified.

smartQare simplifies patient monitoring by replacing spot-checks, multiple devices, and complex setups with one continuous, real-time solution. It supports more efficient workflows, reduces complexity, and helps caregivers respond at the right moment with clear, reliable insights.

### [in-hospital monitoring](https://www.smartqare.com/products-solutions/in-hospital-monitoring/)





Spot checks on general wards can leave critical gaps in patient tracking and increase nurse workloads. smartQare’s continuous monitoring solutions provide real-time insights, improving patient safety and giving nurses time back to focus on direct care.

- [![hospital-to-home monitoring](https://www.smartqare.com/images/cached/resample/png/data/uploads/1280/1280/cms_visual_524.png_1753269996_1280x1280.jpg)](https://www.smartqare.com/products-solutions/hospital-to-home-monitoring/ "hospital-to-home monitoring")



### [hospital-to-home monitoring](https://www.smartqare.com/products-solutions/hospital-to-home-monitoring/)





Postoperative recovery requires close monitoring to detect complications early. smartQare makes it easy to track patients remotely as they transition from hospital to home, ensuring safety, supporting recovery, early discharge, reduction of average hospital stays, and even readmissions.

- [![home monitoring](https://www.smartqare.com/images/cached/resample/png/data/uploads/1280/1280/cms_visual_523.png_1753269563_1280x1280.jpg)](https://www.smartqare.com/products-solutions/home-monitoring/ "home monitoring")



### [home monitoring](https://www.smartqare.com/products-solutions/home-monitoring/)





smartQare’s solutions provide continuous care for individuals at home, whether recovering from illness, managing chronic conditions, or maintaining general health. viQtor monitors vital signs, activity, and falls, providing comfort and safety, while giving caregivers valuable insights for better care.

## viQtor powers one of Europe’s largest hospital@home initiatives

smartQare technology will enable continuous remote patient monitoring across the Region Stockholm for the hospital@home program led by Karolinska University Hospital.

Up to 15,000 patients will benefit annually from connected, hospital-level care at home through real-time wearable monitoring.

[Discover the Karolinska initiative](https://www.smartqare.com/smartqare-supports-one-of-europe-s-largest-hospital-at-home-programs-in-region-stockholm/)

![viQtor powers one of Europe’s largest hospital@home initiatives](https://www.smartqare.com/images/cached/resample/png/data/uploads/1280/1075/cms_visual_568.png_1779285597_1280x1075.jpg)

## Discovery Health has chosen viQtor

Proud that smartQare is supporting the **Discovery Care at Home programme** in South Africa together with [Cuviva AB](https://cuviva.com/en/) and [AIRO Health Care](https://www.airohealthcare.com/).

Discovery Health is South Africa’s largest medical scheme administrator and managed care provider, accounting for 38.3% of the total membership of South African medical schemes, with a membership base of approximately 2.7 million.

## [the growing challenges in healthcare](https://www.smartqare.com/the-growing-challenges-in-healthcare/)

Healthcare systems are under growing pressure from an aging population, workforce shortages, and rising costs. Care teams are supporting more patients with increasingly complex needs, often with limited time and resources, leading to higher workloads and strain.

At the same time, the need to make timely, well-informed decisions based on patient data is increasing. This adds complexity to daily care delivery and can affect both care quality and operational efficiency. In this environment, there is a clear need for smarter, more supportive approaches that enable consistent, confident, and timely care.

## PRESSURE – Advancing Remote Cardiovascular Care Beyond the Hospital

PRESSURE (Personal HypErtenSion and Cardiovascular CaRE) is a collaborative innovation project focused on advancing remote patient monitoring for cardiovascular care. This joint initiative brings together smartQare,  FreeSenseSolutions, TU/e (EAISI), Catharina Hospital, and Eurocept Homecare, with support from OPZuid, the European Union, and the Province of North Brabant.

[More information](https://www.smartqare.com/pressure-advancing-remote-cardiovascular-care-beyond-the-hospital/)
